critique: The render is already strong and legible: the TOP view cleanly shows eight blue BRAM banks, the copper multiplier column, the symmetric add/sub pairs, the Barrett reduction spine and the exploded heatsink, and the FRONT/SIDE elevations confirm everything sits on the ground line with the read/twiddle/return buses supported on standoffs — so the visual axes are near their ceiling. The real failure is the one the carried-over reproduce findings flag: the geometry visualizes an NTT datapath whose *numbers* are missing, so a competent engineer still cannot rebuild it. No part carried a concrete q, Barrett (mu, k, corrections), twiddle-ROM depth/contents, conflict-free bank/offset equations, FSM state set, radix-4 lane fusion, or pipeline latencies — they were only asserted as properties in prose. This pass leaves the verified-fact geometry untouched and instead writes those parameters into part-level spec blocks (clearly marking source-silent values as reproduction defaults), which is exactly the gap the loop could not close.
changelog: Added metadata.spec.params concrete values: modulus_q=12289 (3*2^12+1, canonical 14-bit negacyclic prime) with a note that the source only says '14-bit NTT-friendly prime'; transform_flavor recorded as 'unstated; PQC/HE implies negacyclic, psi=2048-th root', correcting the impls' cyclic assumption; twiddle_root_constraints and pipeline_latency_cycles added.
Gave twiddle_rom a spec: depth 1024 x 14-bit words storing psi^k / omega^k, fetch-once-broadcast addressing keyed by stage and block index.
Gave mod_red_mult and mod_red_subshift Barrett specs: mu=21843=floor(2^28/q), k=28, input 28-bit, r=x-t*q with <=2 conditional subtractions into [0,q).

Gave crossbar_network a conflict-free addressing spec: bank b(i)=(i+(i>>3)) mod 8, offset o(i)=i>>3, with an honest note that the paper's exact Sec. III equations are reconstructed (the source asserts only the no-conflict property).

Gave schedule_controller an FSM/loop spec (state set + the rearranged factor-constant inner block) and config_radix_selector a radix-2/4 lane-fusion spec (8 lanes -> 4 radix-4 BUs), tying the 33%/20% savings to a rebuildable loop nest.
Updated facts[] 'Benchmark size' and 'Reduction' to cite q=12289 and the Barrett mu/k so annotations match the new specs.
remaining_gaps: q=12289 is a reproduction default, not the source's value; if the original CFNTT benchmark prime is published elsewhere, replace it and recompute mu (currently 21843 for q=12289, k=28).

The conflict-free bank/offset equations in crossbar_network.spec satisfy the no-conflict property but are a reconstruction; transcribe the paper's actual Sec. III bank-index/offset functions when available and reconcile with o(i)=i>>3.
psi/omega are given only by their defining congruences; pin a concrete primitive 2048-th root mod 12289 and store its power table in twiddle_rom.spec for full bit-exactness.

schedule_controller.fsm state-transition table and exact stage/block loop bounds are reconstructed; verify against the paper's scheduling figure that the factor-constant block truly yields the 33% mult / 20% add-sub counts.
Pipeline latencies (mult 3 / add-sub 1 / barrett 4 / reg 1) are plausible defaults, not measured; confirm against the paper's reported cycle counts and clock for the 1024-pt, 8-BU radix-4 core.
